en: Sura 100: Al-'Adiyat

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَـٰدِيَـٰتِ ضَبْحًا
en: By the galloping, panting horses[1],
[1] i.e., those horses that fight for the cause of Allah as they race to attack the enemy.

p.src: 100:2  striking sparks of fire [with their hooves][2],

en: striking sparks of fire [with their hooves][2],
u.src: 100:2  striking sparks of fire [with their hooves][2],

en: [2] While galloping over rocky terrain.
launching raids at dawn[3],
[3] While the enemy is unaware of their raid.

p.src: 100:4  stirring up thereby clouds of dust,

en: stirring up thereby clouds of dust,
u.src: 100:4  stirring up thereby clouds of dust,

p.src: 100:5  plunging thereby into the midst of the enemy[4],

en: plunging thereby into the midst of the enemy[4],
u.src: 100:5  plunging thereby into the midst of the enemy[4],

en: [4] i.e., penetrating into the ranks of the enemy as a surprise attack.

p.src: 100:6  indeed, man is very ungrateful to his Lord[5] –

en: indeed, man is very ungrateful to his Lord[5] –
u.src: 100:6  indeed, man is very ungrateful to his Lord[5] –

en: [5] disobeying Him by not spending in the cause of Allah from what He has given him and commanded him to spend accordingly.

p.src: 100:7  and he himself is a witness to that[6] –

en: and he himself is a witness to that[6] –
u.src: 100:7  and he himself is a witness to that[6] –

en: [6] By his words and actions.

p.src: 100:8  and he is truly extreme in his love of wealth.

en: and he is truly extreme in his love of wealth.
u.src: 100:8  and he is truly extreme in his love of wealth.

p.src: 100:9  Does he not know that when the contents of graves will be overturned,

ar: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
en: Does he not know that when the contents of graves will be overturned,
u.src: 100:9  Does he not know that when the contents of graves will be overturned,

p.src: 100:10  and the secrets of the hearts will be brought to light[7]?

en: and the secrets of the hearts will be brought to light[7]?
u.src: 100:10  and the secrets of the hearts will be brought to light[7]?

en: [7] i.e., when all secrets of the hearts and faiths are made known.

p.src: 100:11  Indeed, their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day[8].

en: Indeed, their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day[8].
u.src: 100:11  Indeed, their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day[8].

en: [8] Nothing of their affairs will be hidden from Him.
